description:
Resolve a wheat gene symbol (e.g. Lr34, Rht-B1) or IWGSC gene ID in any RefSeq version
(v1.0 TraesCS..01G, v1.1 TraesCS..02G, v2.1 TraesCS..03G, CSS2014 Traes_..) to all versions,
genomic locations, curated symbol/trait (with verification status), Watkins pangenome presence and links.
name: resolve_gene
